title: Branch hours
text: Branches are open Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM. Online and phone banking are available 24 hours a day.

title: Downtown branch
text: The Downtown branch is at 100 Main Street, with a drive-through ATM available 24 hours a day.

title: Riverside branch
text: The Riverside branch is at 450 River Road, next to the public library, with free customer parking.

title: Overdraft fee policy
text: An overdraft fee of 35 dollars applies per item if an account balance goes below zero, up to a maximum of 3 fees per day.

title: Wire transfer fees
text: Outgoing domestic wire transfers cost 25 dollars. Outgoing international wire transfers cost 45 dollars. Incoming wires are free.

title: Transaction dispute policy
text: Disputed transactions are reviewed within 5 business days. Provisional credit may be issued within 10 business days while the investigation continues.

title: Lost or stolen card policy
text: A lost or stolen card is cancelled immediately upon report and a replacement is mailed within 5 to 7 business days, or available same-day at any branch.
